plan: possession-v2.6 (frame-dependent team-switch cost from a learned switch hazard, v2.1 path)
motivation: Reporting-only oracle check on the 8 v2.1 validation copies (oracle_parts.json): replacing P(dead) by the provider labels raises spellF1 only 0.631 -> 0.647, replacing P(home|alive) raises it to 0.912. Team decisions during play, especially quick changes (51% of changes found within 1 s), are the main error. The decoder uses one constant switch cost (3); a learned probability that a change happens near frame t can make switches cheap where the evidence for a change is local and expensive elsewhere.

candidate.hazard_target: 1 if a direct H<->A change of the provider labels lies within +-12 frames (0.5 s), alive frames only
candidate.hazard_features: the 227 stage-1 features + the 48 stage-2 (stack) features from out-of-fold stage-1 probabilities (cache/oof_f2.pkl for the 4 training matches); team-symmetric by averaging both team views
candidate.hazard_model: HistGradientBoostingClassifier with the stage-1 hyper-parameters (300 iterations, lr 0.06, 31 leaves, min leaf 200, l2 1.0), training matches DFL J03WOH/J03WOY/J03WPY/J03WQQ, seeds 1-3, every 3rd alive frame, both team views
candidate.decoder: possession/decode2.py: switch_t = max(0, s0 - beta * logit(h_t)); out/in cost 60, dead bias -0.3 unchanged
candidate.scope: only the v2.1 path of v2.4 (the v2.3 path keeps its decoder); models, features, noise gate and fusion unchanged

selection.grid: s0 in {2,3,4,5,6,8} x beta in {0,0.5,1,1.5,2} (beta 0, s0 3 is the v2.1 decoder)
selection.selected_on: the 8 original v2.1 validation copies (DFL J03WN1, J03WR9, Metrica 1-2; seeds 101/102), mean spellF1, macroF1 tie-break
selection.confirmation: 8 FRESH copies (seeds 4100 + 10*i + j, v2.1 corruption, never used before); the selected decoder vs the v2.1 decoder on the same stage-2 probabilities

select_v2_6_only_if_all: fresh copies: not worse than v2.4 on at least 5 of the 8 copies
selection_rule.then: final hazard model on the 6 DFL matches with out-of-fold stage-1 probabilities (as possession.train builds stage 2), stored in its own file next to the frozen bundles; joint check with the broadcast fill (if selected) reported on fresh copies; final fresh test on DFL J03WMX after freezing

limits_stated_in_advance: Selection and confirmation copies come from the same four validation matches (only the corruption is new for the confirmation).
Provider label semantics (DFL BallPossession changes on short touches) shape the hazard target; the organisers' definition of a controlled possession may differ.
The v2.3 path is not changed by this candidate.
